Name: Stack to nearby chests
Author: Ilyaki
Description:
Adds a new button to the inventory UI.
It will move any items from your inventory into nearby chests if they contain at least 1 of the item.
(Yes, I copied this from Terraria)

- This also works with fridges, mills etc.

[s]-Unfortunately this will not work with gamepads: only the mouse
>In 1.2.0 you can now Stack with a button on a controller. Default it RightStick. The UI button will still not work though.
[/s][color=#00ff00]> Completely fixed in 1.4+ Now it works as if it was part of the game.[/color]


[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Configuration[/size][list=1]
[*]Open config.json in the StackToNearbyChests directory
[*]"Radius" is the distance in tiles that will be searched for chests to stack into
[*][s]"ControllerButton" is the button on a Game Pad that will activate a Stack. Set to nothing if you want to disable controller input. A list of availible buttons can be found [url=http://www.monogame.net/documentation/?page=T_Microsoft_Xna_Framework_Input_Buttons]here[/url]﻿[/s] (Removed in 1.4+)

[/list]

[size=5]Multiplayer information[/size]
The mod must be installed per player who wants to use the button. The host is not required to install the mod if the clients has installed, and the clients are not required to install the mod if the host has installed.

Source code: [url=https://github.com/Ilyaki/StackToNearbyChests]https://github.com/Ilyaki/StackToNearbyChests[/url]
